description: Notification sent to students when exam details are updated
subject: Exam Updated: $module_code - $module_name
body:
Dear Student/Instructor,

IMPORTANT: The exam details for the following module have been updated:

Module: $module_code - $module_name
Date: $exam_date
Time: $start_time - $end_time
Room: $room
Instructor: $instructor_name

Please review these updated details and make note of any changes.

If you have any questions, please contact your instructor or the examination office.

Best regards,
University Examination Office
